series.name: Splits — Inverter & Fixed-Speed (shared platform)
series.notes: Dawlance splits share one OEM code platform across Powercon/Enercon/Sprinter/Aura/Elegance/Chrome/Mega/etc. and fixed-speed Fix models. Official Mega T+ 15/30 manual (F01000019200) confirms E1/E2/E6/E4 only; the wider E/F/P set comes from PK service blogs and technician videos — see per-code confidence. Source conflicts (E4/E5/E6/E9/F0) are recorded in each code's notes. Codes seen only in bijlibazar tag taxonomy with no published meaning: C1, H1, H6, L1, L3. Codes tagged in multi-brand videos but without Dawlance-specific meanings: EH00, EC51, EC52, EC53. Codes without numeric display: RUN lamp blinks the code number (E1=1 flash, E2=2, E6=6) on display-less models. Reset (all models): remote OFF → breaker OFF → wait 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON. Dawlance service UAN 021-111-11-7359.

meaning.en: The unit is running an automatic defrost cycle to clear ice from the outdoor coil. Normal in cold weather, especially on heat models.
meaning.ur: Unit khud outdoor coil ki barf saaf kar raha hai (defrost). Sardi mein heat mode mein yeh bilkul normal hai.

causes.en: Normal automatic defrost cycle
causes.ur: Automatic defrost cycle chal raha hai — koi masla nahi

solutions.en: Wait for the cycle to finish; the unit resumes by itself
solutions.ur: Thodi der wait karein, cycle khud khatam hoke unit normal ho jayegi

solutions.en: If it defrosts non-stop for hours, book a technician (sensor/gas issue)
solutions.ur: Ghanton tak lagataar defrost ho to technician bulayain (sensor/gas masla ho sakta hai)

source.title: Dawlance Powercon user manual display legend (p.15, 'dF when defrosting') + AysOnline table

meaning.en: Display indicator: anti-cold air feature is active (prevents blowing cold air before the coil is ready). Not a fault.
meaning.ur: Display par signal hai — anti-cold air mode on hai taake coil tayyar honay se pehle thandi hawa na uday. Fault nahi.

causes.en: Feature enabled / active in current mode
causes.ur: Feature current mode mein on hai

solutions.en: No action needed; indicator turns off when the feature ends
solutions.ur: Kuch nahi karna; feature khatam hote hi indicator band ho jayega

source.title: Dawlance Powercon user manual p.15 Display Code Meanings

meaning.en: Display indicator: the unit's self-cleaning function is running. Not a fault.
meaning.ur: Unit ka self-clean (apni safai) function chal raha hai. Fault nahi.

causes.en: Self-clean cycle started by user or automatically
causes.ur: User ne self-clean start kiya hai ya auto chalu hua

solutions.en: Let the cycle finish; do not switch off mid-cycle
solutions.ur: Cycle complete hone dein, darmiyan mein band na karein

source.title: Dawlance Powercon user manual p.15 Display Code Meanings ('SC when unit is self-cleaning')

meaning.en: Display indicator: the 8°C anti-freeze heating feature is active (some models). Not a fault.
meaning.ur: 8°C wali heating feature (frost protection) on hai — kuch models mein. Fault nahi.

causes.en: 8°C heating / frost-protection feature active
causes.ur: 8°C heating feature active hai

solutions.en: No action needed; turn the feature off from remote if not required
solutions.ur: Kuch nahi karna; na chahiye to remote se feature band karein

source.title: Dawlance Powercon user manual p.15 Display Code Meanings

meaning.en: E0 fires on Dawlance inverter units (technician videos) but no Dawlance source publishes its meaning. On similar OEM platforms E0 is usually an indoor–outdoor communication fault.
meaning.ur: Dawlance inverter par E0 aata hai (technician videos se pata chala) lekin iska official meaning koi source nahi batata. Same platform par aam tor par E0 indoor–outdoor communication ki fault hoti hai.

causes.en: Usually indoor–outdoor communication failure (on similar platforms)
causes.ur: Aam tor par indoor–outdoor communication fail hona

causes.en: Loose interconnect cable or PCB fault
causes.ur: Interconnect cable dhila hona ya PCB ka masla

solutions.en: Power cycle: remote off, breaker off 10 minutes, on again
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off, breaker 10 minute off, phir on

solutions.en: If it returns, check indoor–outdoor wire terminals (power isolated) or call service
solutions.ur: Wapas aaye to power band karke wire terminals check karein ya service bulayain

notes.en: Confirmed to appear on Dawlance hardware by technician videos only; meaning is inferred from similar OEM platforms — verify on your model's manual.
notes.ur: Sirf technician videos se confirm hua hai ke E0 Dawlance par aata hai; meaning similar platform se andaza hai — apne model ki manual se confirm karein.

source.title: Forever Tech — E0 Error Dawlance Inverter AC (YouTube)

title.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The indoor room air temperature sensor (T1) is faulty or its connection is loose. The official manual shows this as RUN lamp flashing once on display-less models.
meaning.ur: Room ka temperature sensor (T1) kharab hai ya uski wire dhili hai. Bina display wali models par RUN lamp ek baar flash karta hai.

causes.en: Faulty or drifted room temperature sensor
causes.ur: Room temperature sensor kharab ya drift ho gaya

causes.en: Loose sensor plug / damaged wire at indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug dhila ya indoor PCB par wire tooti hui

causes.en: Sensor placed in direct sunlight or near a heat source
causes.ur: Sensor dhoop ya heat source ke qareeb laga hua

solutions.en: Power cycle first (breaker off 5–10 min)
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein — breaker 5–10 minute off

solutions.en: Check sensor seating and wiring at the indoor PCB (power isolated)
solutions.ur: Power band karke sensor ki wiring indoor PCB par check karein

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance and replace if out of spec (technician)
solutions.ur: Technician sensor ki resistance nape aur zaroorat ho to badlein

source.title: Dawlance Mega T+ 15/30 Inverter official user manual F01000019200, p.28 ERROR SIGNALS

title.ur: Indoor pipe/coil temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The indoor evaporator pipe temperature sensor (T2) is faulty or disconnected. RUN lamp flashes twice on display-less models.
meaning.ur: Evaporator pipe ka sensor (T2) kharab ya disconnect hai. Bina display wali models par RUN lamp do baar flash karta hai.

causes.en: Faulty pipe sensor or loose connection
causes.ur: Pipe sensor kharab ya connection dhila

causes.en: Sensor wire damaged by rats or during service
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire chuhe ya service ke dauran toot gayi

causes.en: Sensor fallen out of the coil pocket
causes.ur: Sensor coil ki pocket se bahar aa gaya

solutions.en: Power cycle, then inspect sensor placement in the coil
solutions.ur: Reset karein, phir sensor ko coil mein theek se lagwa kar check karein

solutions.en: Check wiring continuity to the indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Indoor PCB tak wiring ki continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if resistance is wrong (technician)
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat ho to sensor badlein (technician)

source.title: Dawlance Mega T+ official user manual F01000019200, p.28; corroborated by Maqsood & Sons, BijliBazar

meaning.en: The outdoor condenser coil temperature sensor (T3) or its wiring is faulty. Very common in Pakistani summers.
meaning.ur: Outdoor condenser coil ka sensor (T3) ya uski wire kharab hai. Pakistani garmiyon mein yeh bohat common hai.

causes.en: Faulty outdoor coil sensor
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor kharab

causes.en: Wiring damaged or connector loose at outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par wire dhili ya tooti hui

causes.en: Outdoor unit overheating / blocked airflow
causes.ur: Outdoor unit overheat ho raha hai ya hawa ka rasta block hai

solutions.en: Power off; check outdoor unit has 2+ feet clearance and clean coil
solutions.ur: Power off karke outdoor ke aage 2 feet khali jagah aur saaf coil check karein

solutions.en: Inspect sensor and connector at outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par sensor aur connector check karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if readings are wrong (technician)
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat ho to sensor badlein (technician)

source.title: AysOnline + Maqsood & Sons + BijliBazar Dawlance error tables

title.en: Refrigerant Leakage (official) — some sources: indoor fan
title.ur: Gas leak (official) — kuch sources: indoor fan

meaning.en: Official Dawlance manual: refrigerant leakage. Several PK blogs instead call E4 an indoor fan motor error — meaning is model-dependent.
meaning.ur: Official Dawlance manual: gas leak. Lekin kuch PK blogs E4 ko indoor fan motor ki fault kehte hain — matlab model par depend karta hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak in the system (official meaning)
causes.ur: System mein gas leak hai (official wala matlab)

causes.en: Indoor fan blocked or motor failed (alternate PK-blog meaning)
causes.ur: Indoor fan block ya motor kharab (PK blogs wala alternate matlab)

solutions.en: If cooling is weak / ice on pipes: stop use, technician leak-test + recharge
solutions.ur: Cooling kam ho ya pipes par barf ho to band karein — technician leak test aur gas charge kare ga

solutions.en: If fan noise stopped / blower not running: check indoor fan and capacitor (technician)
solutions.ur: Fan ki awaaz band ho gayi ho to indoor fan aur capacitor check karein (technician)

solutions.en: Verify the meaning against your model's manual when possible
solutions.ur: Ho sake to apne model ki manual se meaning confirm karein

notes.en: CONFLICT: Official Mega T+ manual F01000019200 says 'Refrigerant leakage'. AysOnline/Maqsood/BijliBazar say 'indoor fan motor error'. Likely different firmware generations — treat as model-dependent.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: Official manual kehti hai gas leak; PK blogs kehti hain indoor fan motor. Alag firmware generations ho sakte hain — matlab model par depend karta hai.

source.title: Dawlance Mega T+ official manual p.28 (primary) vs AysOnline/Maqsood/BijliBazar (alternate)

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units have stopped communicating (most widely reported meaning on Dawlance). Other sources call it outdoor fan or overload.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units aapas mein baat karna band kar gaye (sab se zyada reported meaning). Doosre sources ise outdoor fan ya overload kehte hain.

causes.en: Loose, corroded or broken interconnect (communication) cable
causes.ur: Interconnect/communication cable dhili, zang ya tooti hui

causes.en: Poor power supply / voltage fluctuations disturbing comms
causes.ur: Voltage fluctuation communication ko bigaar rahi hai

causes.en: Outdoor main PCB or IPM board fault (technician videos)
causes.ur: Outdoor main PCB ya IPM board ka masla (technician videos)

solutions.en: Power cycle first
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein (breaker 5–10 min off)

solutions.en: Power isolated: check both terminal blocks — wires tight and clean
solutions.ur: Power band karke dono terminal blocks check karein — wires saaf aur kasi hui hon

solutions.en: Use a voltage stabilizer if the area has low/high voltage
solutions.ur: Ilake mein voltage kharab ho to stabilizer lagwayein

solutions.en: If still there: technician checks outdoor PCB (common Dawlance E5 repair)
solutions.ur: Phir bhi aaye to technician outdoor PCB check kare (Dawlance mein E5 ka common repair)

notes.en: CONFLICT: AysOnline/Maqsood = communication; BijliBazar table = outdoor fan motor; Scribd list = compressor/inverter overload. Communication is the majority meaning and matches technician video practice (outdoor PCB repair).
notes.ur: CONFLICT: AysOnline/Maqsood = communication; BijliBazar = outdoor fan; Scribd = compressor overload. Communication sab se zyada sources par milta hai.

source.title: AysOnline 'E5 and E8 — communication errors' + Maqsood & Sons

meaning.en: Official manual: indoor fan motor malfunction (RUN lamp flashes 6 times). Other PK sources say outdoor fan or communication.
meaning.ur: Official manual: indoor fan motor kharab (RUN lamp 6 baar flash). Doosre PK sources outdoor fan ya communication kehte hain.

causes.en: Indoor blower blocked, stiff or motor failed
causes.ur: Indoor blower jam, fan motor kharab

causes.en: Fan wiring/connector loose at indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par fan ki wire dhili

causes.en: Fan capacitor degraded (fixed-speed models)
causes.ur: Fan capacitor kamzor (fixed-speed models)

solutions.en: Power off; check the indoor blower spins freely by hand
solutions.ur: Power off karke indoor blower haath se azaad ghoom raha ho check karein

solutions.en: Clear dust/blockage from blower and filters
solutions.ur: Blower aur filters ki gandagi saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician: test fan motor voltages/continuity and replace if dead
solutions.ur: Technician fan motor ki voltage/continuity check kare aur kharab ho to badle

notes.en: CONFLICT: Official manual = indoor fan motor. Maqsood & Sons = outdoor fan motor. Scribd = communication malfunction. Official wording used as primary.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: Official = indoor fan; Maqsood = outdoor fan; Scribd = communication. Official ko primary rakha hai.

source.title: Dawlance Mega T+ official manual F01000019200 p.28 ERROR SIGNALS

meaning.en: E7 appears on Dawlance DC inverter units in PCB-repair videos; no Dawlance source publishes its meaning. On similar platforms it is often an outdoor/communication class fault.
meaning.ur: Dawlance DC inverter par E7 PCB repair videos mein aata hai; koi source meaning nahi batata. Similar platforms par yeh aam tor par outdoor/communication class ki fault hoti hai.

causes.en: Outdoor PCB / communication class fault (typical on similar platforms)
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB / communication class fault (similar platform par aam)

causes.en: Indoor–outdoor interconnect signal wire loose or damaged
causes.ur: Indoor–outdoor interconnect signal wire dhili ya kharab hui

causes.en: Indoor PCB communication circuit fault
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker and isolate the supply before you open any panel or probe the indoor–outdoor communication wiring.
solutions.ur: Pehle breaker se power band karke supply isolate karein, phir hi panel kholein ya indoor–outdoor communication wire check karein.

solutions.en: Power cycle once — remote off, breaker off 5–10 minutes, breaker on, remote on — and watch whether E7 returns on the next run.
solutions.ur: Ek baar reset karein — remote off, breaker 5–10 minute band, breaker on, remote on — aur dekhein agle run par E7 wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it repeats: technician checks the outdoor PCB, the interconnect signal wire and connector seating — do not keep restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to technician outdoor PCB, interconnect signal wire aur connector ki seating check kare — unit ko baar baar restart na karein.

notes.en: Only evidenced by Dawlance-tagged PCB-repair video titles (Babar Electronics). Meaning unverified — do not assume; confirm on the unit.
notes.ur: Sirf Dawlance-tagged PCB repair video titles se pata chala. Meaning unverified — assume na karein; unit par confirm karein.

source.title: Babar Electronics HVACR — Dawlance DC inverter E7 (YouTube titles/tags)

title.en: Display Board ↔ Main PCB Communication Fault
title.ur: Display board aur main PCB mein communication fault

meaning.en: The indoor display board is not communicating with the main indoor PCB (loose ribbon cable or board failure).
meaning.ur: Indoor display board aur main PCB aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (ribbon cable dhili ya board kharab).

causes.en: Loose or unseated ribbon cable between display and PCB
causes.ur: Display aur PCB ke darmiyan ribbon cable dhili

causes.en: Faulty display board
causes.ur: Display board kharab

causes.en: Faulty main indoor PCB
causes.ur: Main indoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Power off; reseat the display ribbon cable carefully
solutions.ur: Power off karke display ribbon cable ko savadhani se dobara lagayein

solutions.en: If code returns: technician tests/replaces display board or PCB
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician display board ya PCB test/badalay

notes.en: CONFLICT: PK blogs (AysOnline/Maqsood/BijliBazar) agree on display↔PCB; Scribd list says 'indoor fan protection'. Blog meaning used.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: PK blogs display↔PCB par ittefaq rakhein; Scribd kehti hai indoor fan protection. Blog wala matlab use kiya.

source.title: AysOnline + Maqsood & Sons + BijliBazar Dawlance tables

meaning.en: System pressure dropped too low — usually refrigerant leak or blockage. The unit has shut down to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: System ka pressure bohat neeche aa gaya — aam tor par gas leak ya blockage. Compressor ko mehfooz karne ke liye unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak (flare joints, coil, service valves)
causes.ur: Gas leak — flare joints, coil ya service valves par

causes.en: Blockage in filter/drier or capillary
causes.ur: Filter/drier ya capillary mein blockage

causes.en: Indoor airflow very low (dirty filter/coil) causing freezing
causes.ur: Indoor airflow bohat kam (ganda filter/coil) — barf jamna

solutions.en: Stop the unit; check for ice on pipes (sign of low gas/airflow)
solutions.ur: Unit band karein; pipes par barf dekhein (kam gas/airflow ka nishani)

solutions.en: Clean filters and ensure indoor/outdoor airflow
solutions.ur: Filters saaf karein aur dono taraf airflow confirm karein

solutions.en: Technician: pressure test, find leak, repair and recharge
solutions.ur: Technician pressure test karega, leak dhoondega, repair aur gas charge karega

notes.en: CONFLICT: AysOnline/BijliBazar = low pressure; Scribd list = 'water flow' (drain) protection. Low-pressure meaning used (majority + physically common).
notes.ur: CONFLICT: AysOnline/BijliBazar = low pressure; Scribd = water flow/drain. Low-pressure matlab rakha (zyada sources + common).

source.title: AysOnline Dawlance table (E9 low pressure) + BijliBazar

meaning.en: The compressor has overheated or drawn excessive current, so protection stopped it. A real user (PakWheels) reported EC on a Dawlance Inspire Plus; helpline said circuit-related.
meaning.ur: Compressor overheat ho gaya ya zyada current le raha tha, protection ne band kar diya. Ek user ne Dawlance Inspire Plus par EC report kiya; helpline ne circuit wali baat kahi.

causes.en: Compressor overheating (dirty condenser, high ambient, blocked airflow)
causes.ur: Compressor overheat (ganda condenser, zyada bahar ki heat, block hawa)

causes.en: Low refrigerant causing long hard running
causes.ur: Kam gas ki wajah se compressor lambi der takleef ke saath chalta raha

causes.en: Weak capacitor / voltage problems / stuck compressor
causes.ur: Kamzor capacitor, voltage masla, ya compressor jam

solutions.en: Switch off and let the compressor cool for at least 30 minutes
solutions.ur: Band karein aur compressor ko kam az kam 30 minute thanda hone dein

solutions.en: Clean outdoor coil and clear space around the outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil saaf karein aur ird-gird jagah khali karein

solutions.en: Check supply voltage / stabilizer
solutions.ur: Supply voltage / stabilizer check karein

solutions.en: If EC repeats: technician checks capacitor, relay, amps, compressor
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to technician capacitor, relay, ampere, compressor check kare

source.title: AysOnline + Maqsood & Sons + Forever Tech video + PakWheels user report

title.en: Outdoor Fan Motor Error / Outdoor Unit Protection
title.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya outdoor unit protection

meaning.en: Most-reported: outdoor fan motor not running correctly. Other Dawlance sources describe it as general outdoor unit or refrigerant-system protection.
meaning.ur: Sab se zyada: outdoor fan theek nahi chal raha. Doosre sources ise general outdoor unit ya gas system ki protection kehte hain.

causes.en: Outdoor fan blocked by debris or fan motor failed
causes.ur: Outdoor fan dhool/debris se block ya fan motor kharab

causes.en: Outdoor fan capacitor weak
causes.ur: Outdoor fan capacitor kamzor

causes.en: Gas pressure imbalance (alternate meaning)
causes.ur: Gas pressure imbalance (alternate matlab)

solutions.en: Power off; clear debris around outdoor fan and check blades turn freely
solutions.ur: Power off karke outdoor fan ke aage se dhool saaf karein, blade azaad ghoomay.

solutions.en: Technician: test fan motor and capacitor
solutions.ur: Technician fan motor aur capacitor test kare

solutions.en: If general protection: check pressures/gas (technician)
solutions.ur: Agar general protection ho to technician pressure/gas check kare

notes.en: CONFLICT: AysOnline = outdoor fan motor; Maqsood = general outdoor unit protection; BijliBazar = refrigerant system protection; Scribd snippet = indoor room… (truncated). Outdoor-fan meaning used as primary (most specific + 2 sources).
notes.ur: CONFLICT: AysOnline = outdoor fan; Maqsood = general outdoor protection; BijliBazar = gas system; Scribd = truncated. Outdoor fan ko primary rakha.

source.title: AysOnline Dawlance table (F0 outdoor fan motor)

meaning.en: The outdoor inverter power module (IPM) tripped — overheat, electrical fault or poor airflow around the module heatsink.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter power module (IPM) trip ho gaya — overheat, electrical fault ya heatsink ke paas hawa na hona.

causes.en: Module overheating / blocked outdoor airflow
causes.ur: Module zyada garam ho jana ya outdoor airflow band hona

causes.en: Voltage spikes damaging the drive stage
causes.ur: Voltage spike se drive stage thes

causes.en: IPM or outdoor PCB failure
causes.ur: IPM ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Power off and let the unit cool; improve clearance around outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Power off karke unit ko thanda hone dein; outdoor ke aage jagah barhayein

solutions.en: Power cycle once after cooling
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad ek baar reset karein

solutions.en: If it returns: technician-level outdoor PCB/IPM repair — do not keep restarting
solutions.ur: Wapas aaye to technician outdoor PCB/IPM dekhe — baar baar restart na karein

notes.en: CONFLICT: BijliBazar's prose section calls F1 'indoor sensor communication error' while its own table says outdoor module protection — table meaning used (matches AysOnline/Maqsood and PCB-repair videos).
notes.ur: CONFLICT: BijliBazar ke prose mein F1 'indoor sensor communication' hai jabke usi ki table mein 'outdoor module' hai — table wala matlab use kiya.

source.title: AysOnline + Maqsood & Sons + Forever Tech/Babar F1 videos

meaning.en: The power factor correction stage of the outdoor board reported a fault — usually unstable mains supply or a PFC circuit problem.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka PFC stage fault batata hai — aam tor par kharab mains voltage ya PFC circuit ka masla.

causes.en: Unstable / low / high mains voltage
causes.ur: Mains voltage unstable, kam ya zyada

causes.en: PFC capacitor/reactor or board fault
causes.ur: PFC capacitor/reactor ya board kharab

causes.en: Loose supply wiring
causes.ur: Supply wiring dhili

solutions.en: Check input voltage with a meter; use a stabilizer in bad areas
solutions.ur: Meter se input voltage check karein; kharab area mein stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: Power cycle after voltage is stable
solutions.ur: Voltage theek hone par reset karein

solutions.en: If repeats on stable supply: technician board service
solutions.ur: Theek voltage par baar baar aaye to technician board service kare

source.title: AysOnline + Maqsood & Sons + BijliBazar (F2 PFC)

title.ur: Compressor start nahi ho pa raha

meaning.en: The compressor did not start within the expected time — start relay, capacitor, wiring or compressor winding problem.
meaning.ur: Compressor mutawaqqa time par start nahi hua — start relay, capacitor, wiring ya compressor winding ka masla.

causes.en: Weak/damaged start relay or capacitor
causes.ur: Start relay ya capacitor kamzor/kharab

causes.en: Compressor windings open/short or compressor stuck
causes.ur: Compressor winding open/short ya compressor jam

causes.en: Low voltage at start
causes.ur: Start par voltage kam

solutions.en: Check supply voltage under load (technician)
solutions.ur: Technician load par voltage check kare

solutions.en: Technician tests relay/capacitor and compressor continuity to earth
solutions.ur: Technician relay/capacitor aur compressor ki continuity to earth check kare

solutions.en: Compressor replacement if windings are bad
solutions.ur: Winding kharab ho to compressor badalna parega

title.ur: F4 code (aam tor par discharge sensor)

meaning.en: F4 fires on Dawlance DC inverter units (technician videos) but no Dawlance text source defines it. On similar platforms F4 is usually the compressor discharge/exhaust temperature sensor.
meaning.ur: Dawlance DC inverter par F4 aata hai (videos) lekin koi Dawlance source define nahi karta. Similar platform par F4 aam tor par compressor discharge/exhaust sensor hota hai.

causes.en: Discharge temperature sensor open/short or out of position
causes.ur: Discharge sensor open/short ya jagah se hat gaya

causes.en: Compressor overheating (high discharge temp)
causes.ur: Compressor overheat (discharge temp zyada)

causes.en: Outdoor PCB sensor input fault
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input fault

solutions.en: Power off and cool down; clean filters and outdoor coil
solutions.ur: Power off karke thanda hone dein; filters aur outdoor coil saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician: check discharge sensor resistance and seating
solutions.ur: Technician discharge sensor ki resistance aur jagah check kare

solutions.en: If sensor OK: check gas charge and compressor (technician)
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to gas charge aur compressor check karein (technician)

notes.en: Dawlance occurrence confirmed by Forever Tech/Babar videos; meaning taken from the common multi-brand convention — verify on your model.
notes.ur: Dawlance par aana videos se confirm; meaning multi-brand aam practice se li gaya — apne model par verify karein.

source.title: Forever Tech — Dawlance DC inverter F4/F6 error codes (YouTube)

meaning.ur: F5 published Dawlance range (E0–F5 + EH) mein hai lekin koi source Dawlance ka matlab nahi batata. Similar platforms par F5 aam tor par PFC ya outdoor sensor hota hai.

causes.en: Unverified for Dawlance — check model manual

title.ur: EC53 — ambient temperature sensor (multi-brand, confirm nahi)

meaning.en: Multi-brand inverter sources describe EC53 as a faulty ambient temperature sensor (fast-blinking LED). Videos tag Dawlance among affected brands — not Dawlance-confirmed.
meaning.ur: Multi-brand sources EC53 ko kharab ambient temperature sensor batate hain (fast blinking LED). Videos mein Dawlance bhi tag hai — Dawlance-confirmed nahi.

causes.en: Faulty ambient temperature sensor
causes.ur: Ambient temperature sensor kharab

causes.en: Sensor connector loose at outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par sensor connector dhila

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker and isolate the supply before opening the outdoor unit to reach the ambient temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature sensor par kaam karne ke liye outdoor unit kholne se pehle breaker se power band karke supply isolate karein.

solutions.en: Visually check the ambient sensor at the outdoor unit: make sure its connector is seated on the PCB and the lead is not cut, brittle or water-logged.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par ambient sensor visually check karein: connector PCB par achi tarah laga ho aur lead kati na hui, phati na ho ya paani mein na ho.

solutions.en: Technician measures the ambient sensor (NTC) at room temperature and replaces it if the reading is out of range; reset the unit afterwards and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Technician ambient sensor (NTC) room temperature par naape aur reading ghalat ho to sensor badal de; phir unit ka reset karke code clear hone confirm karein.
